svg.title: ECB versus CBC: why the mode of operation matters
svg.desc: The same image is encrypted with AES twice. In ECB mode every identical block encrypts to the same ciphertext, so the shapes of the original image remain visible. In CBC mode each block is chained to the previous ciphertext and a random IV, so the result looks like random noise.
svg.text: ECB versus CBC: why the mode of operation matters
Never use ECB for data longer than one block; prefer an AEAD mode such as AES-GCM.
